decisions.reason: As a style-led decorative variant with only an initial 2019 website push, it is easier for management by 2022 to discontinue it than to keep justifying it.
This transparent burnout decorative fabric appears more like a collection item than a strategic pillar, so limited commitment is unlikely to outweigh normal portfolio refresh pressure.
The firm has some incentive to persist because it launched the product publicly, but a standard burnout decorative fabric remains a relatively replaceable line by 2022.
A velour-like upholstery fabric sits closer to a durable core furnishing offer, so prior investment and public commitment make continued marketing somewhat more likely than withdrawal.
Its flame-retardant functional positioning fits a steadier B2B niche, making management more inclined to continue and attribute any weak results to temporary conditions.
Although not highly strategic, this satin-sheen polyester lining fabric is a basic category where sunk development and sourcing effort still slightly favor retention over an immediate cut.
